title: Investigation into former managers of a brake manufacturer (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. The public prosecutor's office in Neustadt-Rhein has opened an investigation against two former managers of Fennic Railway Brakes GmbH on suspicion of falsifying test certificates for rail brake pads delivered between 2023 and 2025. Searches were carried out at the company's main plant on 11 August 2026. The company has said it is cooperating fully with the authorities. The investigation is at an early stage and the suspects are presumed innocent.
